Team,

I'm kicking off a quick preflight to tighten our renewal forecast for next month. I attached a working workbook (renewal-visibility-matrix.xlsx) with a new tab for 'preflight flags' — please do the following by EOD Wednesday (48 hours):

- Update Stage (Contracted / Near-Commit / At-Risk / Lost) for each account you own.
- Set Commit Confidence (High / Medium / Low) and add a short reason when you mark Medium or Low.
- For any account where "churn_signal_score" >= 30% mark Action Required and add outreach owner. We want a concrete next-step (CSM touch, legal delay, procurement hold).
- Note billing cadence changes or pending PO redlines under the Finance notes column.

I'm seeding BrightByte (example row) with the details we currently have. They're on an annual contract with an auto-renew clause but finance flagged a potential pricing inquiry (Elaine Su). If you touch BrightByte, please coordinate with Naomi on billing offsets and confirm the effective renewal date in the sheet.

Why this matters: a handful of late-stage accounts with weak commit confidence are driving volatility in the May forecast. The objective for this preflight is to reduce OC variance by 30% through clarified ownership and explicit fallbacks (short-term credit, canary roll, or executive outreach).

Attachments: renewal-visibility-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Elaine — thanks for the questions and the transparency. Quick answers and our proposed next steps: 

- Committed ARR on file: $468,000 annual renewal, next renewal date: 2026-06-15 (per Marissa's update).
- Pro-rated add-ons: We handle seat/usage add-ons as contract amendments that are pro-rated from the effective date; the base annual rate can be locked via amendment language.
- If you want to lock the 12-month base rate while piloting monthly add-ons, we can formalize that via a short amendment and a 30-day pilot clause. Naomi — can you confirm whether a pilot with monthly invoices requires a new billing schedule or if we can keep a single annual invoice and bill the pilot separately?
